title: Concept: Legacy cipher selected through Cipher.getInstance in scala — review required
description: In scala, Cipher.getInstance is given a legacy transformation. The JVM will supply the algorithm, so the code works, but the primitive no longer provides the margin expected of encryption at rest or in transit. Legacy names also tend to arrive with ECB or fixed IV defaults that compound the weakness.
applicability: scala services that encrypt stored or transmitted data.
risk: Recoverable plaintext through algorithm weakness; MEDIUM severity.
